I can help with that. To build a plan that fits you, I'd want to see what you're already doing for your back. Let me pull your recent training first. Nothing is logged yet, so I can't see your back work or your current program. Here's the general approach.

Back is built with a few movement patterns: a vertical pull (pulldowns or pull-ups), a horizontal row (barbell, dumbbell or cable), and some direct work for the upper back and rear delts like face pulls. Most people do well with two back sessions a week, around 3 sets of 8 to 12 reps per exercise, with a weight that leaves 2 or 3 reps in the tank. Add weight when you hit the top of the rep range with clean form, and keep your rest between sets long enough that the last set is still strong.

Log a few sessions and I'll look at where your back is actually lagging. Then we can build it properly, with the engine putting the sessions together for you. Is there a specific piece you want to start with, like rows or pull-ups?
